zh-CN.coach.scene.title: 第 1 步 · 摆场景
zh-CN.coach.scene.body: 从「添加」选择场景模板，再摆放道具和角色。场景是镜头的基础。
zh-CN.coach.mannequin.title: 点假人，人就归你管
zh-CN.coach.mannequin.body: 右侧出「姿势」面板一键换姿势；头顶出「操控」——进去 WASD 走位、录 take。
zh-CN.coach.camera.title: 点相机，运镜归你调
zh-CN.coach.camera.body: 选中相机出画面预览和「运镜预设」——推近 / 环绕 / 希区柯克变焦，13 招一键落轨迹。
zh-CN.coach.add.title: 场景不用自己搭
zh-CN.coach.add.body: 「添加」里有城市街道 / 室内房间场景模板，还有车、树、路灯这些道具。
zh-CN.coach.move.title: 第 4 步 · 整运镜
zh-CN.coach.move.body: 在右侧「整运镜」选择预设、手动轨迹或录 take。运镜就绪后即可出片。
zh-CN.coach.export.title: 第 5 步 · 出片
zh-CN.coach.export.body: 从顶部「出片」导出参考视频、当前画面截图或运镜首尾帧。

en.coach.scene.title: Step 1 · Build the scene
en.coach.scene.body: Choose a scene template from Add, then place props and characters. The scene is the foundation of the shot.
en.coach.mannequin.title: Select a mannequin to direct it
en.coach.mannequin.body: Use the Pose panel on the right, then Possess above the character for WASD blocking and take recording.
en.coach.camera.title: Select a camera to shape the move
en.coach.camera.body: Camera preview and movement presets unlock push-ins, orbits, dolly zooms, and trajectory generation.
en.coach.add.title: Build scenes from templates
en.coach.add.body: Add includes city street and interior room templates, plus cars, trees, streetlamps, and other props.
en.coach.move.title: Step 4 · Shape the camera move
en.coach.move.body: Use Camera move on the right to choose a preset, draw a trajectory, or record a take. Export unlocks when the move is ready.
en.coach.export.title: Step 5 · Export
en.coach.export.body: Use Export at the top to create a reference video, viewport screenshot, or first and last camera frames.
